rationale: unit:shared.embedding matches every cited embed declaration. embedSlots maps Option.map Reference.owned while preserving each key and list position; embedObject preserves className and embeds field slots; embedState preserves object IDs, table order, variable names and nextId. embedPlace recursively retains variable and field names. embedValue maps Given give to Shared give and new to new with identical constructor argument variables, with no giveShare case. embedStatement, embedClasses and embedProgram preserve destinations, class declarations and statement order. embedConfiguration transforms both state and remaining code, so the relationship identifies a point in an execution rather than only an object graph. The required Given and Shared unit selections agree on those domains, including empty slots/classes and variable-give constructor operands. Literal identity preservation is appropriate here; no fresh-ID renaming relation is being silently assumed.
